data.title: 阿米娅 · 舰桥露台的晚风小憩
data.description: 深夜舰桥外缘的观景露台上，微凉的晚风拂过纯黑发丝与毛茸茸的修长兔耳。阿米娅换上了厚实温暖的浅驼色落肩针织毛衣，双手捧着温热的红茶杯，倚在金属栏杆旁。她微微侧过头，深棕色的眼眸倒映着远方璀璨的荒原星空，卸下罗德岛领袖的沉重担子，展露出只属于少女时分的恬静与依恋。
data.location: observation deck of landship bridge under starry sky
data.action: standing at railing holding warm ceramic mug, night breeze fluttering oversized knit sweater and brown hair, gentle affectionate smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: cool starlight and distant nebulae mixed with soft warm deck footlights
data.mood: peaceful quiet sanctuary, heartfelt unburdened warmth
data.promptProse: Standing at the landship observation railing under a canopy of stars, Amiya holds a warm steaming mug. Her oversized knit sweater slips softly over one shoulder as she turns with a peaceful, loving gaze in the cool night breeze.
data.animaCaption: Amiya standing on an observation deck in an oversized sweater under a starry sky.
